description.p: DucTape is a driver station for FIRST Robotics Competition robots on Linux and macOS. It connects to a roboRIO or the WPILib simulator, enables and disables the robot in autonomous, teleoperated and test modes, maps game controllers to joystick ports, and shows the robot console.

DucTape includes a Model Context Protocol server, so AI agents can run the driver station too: check status, enable the robot, run timed tests, read the console and drive a virtual joystick. Agents can be restricted to the simulator, or given time limits.
DucTape is a revival of Conductor, the cross-platform driver station by Kaitlyn Kenwell.
DucTape is not compatible with the Field Management System and cannot be used in competition.
